This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 9" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their red and blue faces.<ref name="Chapter 9" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate}}</ref>, a member of this species was present at [[Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk]] when [[Gor Koresh|Koresh]] attempted to take [[Din Djarin]]'s [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin's armor|armor]].<ref name="Chapter 9" /> Not long after,<ref name="9 ABY Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> at least one other member of the species frequented [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]] in [[Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine]],<ref name="Chapter 1">{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}}</ref> seemingly perishing alongside [[Garsa Fwip|Fwip]] when the [[Pyke Syndicate]] destroyed it.<ref name="Chapter 6">{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:PinkWhiteRedBlue-Mando2Gallery.jpg|right|200px|thumb|This species on the set of ''Chapter 9: The Marshal''.]]
The species made their debut in the [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|ninth episode]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Jon Favreau]].<ref name="Chapter 9" />
